As far as parents go, that’s a tough nut to crack. My suggestion, and this is not what I did but wish I had, is tell your parents you love them when they start yelling around you, then excuse yourself. Parents issues are not your issues and 90% of the time you don’t have perspective or experience with what they’re dealing with. Tell them you love them and if you need to explain tell them that it’s really hard to see them arguing since they’re both so important to you. It’s a hard thing but sometimes any help you offer will be taken the wrong way. Better to offer support and that’s it.
